name: Exploitation for Evasion
summary: Adversaries may exploit a software vulnerability to take advantage of a programming error in a program, service, or within the operating system software or kernel itself to evade detection. Vulnerabilities may exist in software that can be used to disable or circumvent security features. analytics.name: Analytic 1927
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies malformed or out-of-spec ICS protocol exchanges targeting an embedded device from a source outside the approved communication baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

analytics.name: Analytic 2154
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies ptrace syscalls or /proc/pid/mem write operations targeting Industrial Control System (ICS) service processes from a process that is not a debugger or vendor diagnostic tool.
